text:
Mari: Quick design review — putting this here so we can sync on the usage & billing page changes I mocked this morning. Main idea: move away from the single donut to a left-heavy chart + compact project tiles on the right. Feedback? :eyes:
AJ: Sounds reasonable. Donut is pretty but hides trends. If we want org vs project comparison we should show trend lines or small multiples.
Sam: Small multiples would be my +1. Easier to compare top projects at a glance. Also avoids the ambiguous stacking order problem with stacked areas.
Kevin: Implementation heads-up: small multiples means rendering N charts for N projects. We should cap default to top 6 projects and provide a "show more" lazy load. Rendering many Canvas charts on client could spike memory.
Nina: Research note — customers frequently ask for: 1) invoices link near spend, 2) CSV export, 3) clear default granularity (30d/90d/custom). We should keep those affordances visible.
Mari: Ok re: top 6 — that feels right. Proposed layout: left column 60%: trend (tab switch between org/project), right column: stacked project tiles (list with sparkline + current month spend) + invoices card and export CTA.
AJ: UX nit: invoices card needs to show latest invoice date + outstanding balance if any. Also add a subtle badge if new invoice in last 7 days.
Sam: Copy nit for tile headings — current mock uses "Spend" which feels generic. Suggest "This month spend" or "Spend (30d)". Also each tile should show tokens used + USD cost.
Kevin: For the chart toggle, we'll reuse the existing /api/billing/summary endpoint. Query example: `GET /api/billing/summary?level=org&range=30d&projects=proj1,proj2`. We can memoize results server-side for identical date ranges.
Mari: A11y check: current green on the sparkline in the mock fails WCAG AA contrast on a white background at 12px height. Need to move to darker green or add a 1px stroke. Also ensure keyboard focus order: tiles -> invoices -> export.
Nina: I'll run a 5-user quick test with the prototype once we have the top-6 flow. We should ask: "can you find the latest invoice?" and "which project cost more last month?"
AJ: Decision question: default landing view for org-admins — org aggregate or last-viewed project? My vote: org aggregate, with a persistent project picker in top-right so you can switch quickly.
Sam: Agree org aggregate default. For project owners (not org admin) maybe show project-level by default — but that's a permissions branch we can add later.
Kevin: Perf plan: implement server-side downsampling for long ranges, and client will render SVG sparklines for tiles and a single canvas for the main chart. That should keep CPU manageable.
Mari: Copy pass: change header "Overview" -> "Usage & billing overview"; invoices card title -> "Invoices & statements"; export CTA -> "Export charges (CSV)".
AJ: +1. Also thinking about org vs project breadcrumb UI — maybe a pill that reads "Org: AcmeCorp › Project: Payments" so context is explicit.
Nina: Testing checklist: keyboard-only nav, screen reader labels on charts (aria-label summarizing top 3 projects), contrast for all chips, and CSV sample content.
billing-bot: Mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/1759004321-v2 — comments enabled.
Sam: I'll pair with Kevin on perf next week, will also PR a11y fixes for colors.
Kevin: Ack — will scope server endpoints today.
Mari: Great, I'll update the figma with the pill and invoices card changes and iterate copy. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
AJ: Thanks! Will add a small acceptance criteria doc for PMs next.
